subject: Shiny app crashes on protein summarization

messages.author: 11bb7fd12fd82ab5
messages.subject: Shiny app crashes on protein summarization
parts:
Hello,

I've been trying to use the Shiny App, but it seems to repeatedly crash on the Protein Summarization step. The progress bar shows up with 0%, and after being stuck there for 5-10 minutes, the page goes blank saying "this app has been stopped, you can no close this tab."
Restarting/trying several times with different settings has not worked, and I doubt there is something wrong with the file as it was able to successfully upload. Any ideas what I could be doing wrong?

Thank you for any and all suggestions in advance.

Best wishes,

Jacqueline
